findings.title: A zero-life nonpersistent instruction is painted instead of skipped
findings.summary: A normalized frame includes an opaque gray sample where the no-action recommendation calls for transparency.
findings.scope: SHOULD recommendation, not an unconditional SHALL violation. Small normalized timeline/rendering fixture with supplied decoded layers; no public encoded-file route or animation-bit admission claim. The persistent() getter itself correctly returns its stored flag. This overlaps the earlier independent no-action probe and is not an additional root.

findings.title: Allowing SOP makes every packet require an SOP marker
findings.summary: With COD allowing SOP, a complete one-byte empty packet without its optional marker is rejected as truncated.
findings.scope: Parsed coding-style context and production progression preparation lead to a direct packet unit. The failing control has SOP allowed, no EPH, no packed headers, and one empty packet. No complete public image decode is established. Host reproduction is supported by the normative mapping parent; agreement with the narrower internal routing model is not a refutation of that model.

findings.title: A terminal stuffed header byte is mistaken for the EPH marker
findings.summary: The header C0 BE FF 00 is followed by the correct FF92 marker, but inspection skips the terminal stuffing byte in its boundary count and rejects the marker.
findings.scope: Direct inspection unit with one constructor-backed 1x1 decoder, 255 declared opaque body bytes and EPH enabled; Tier-1 body decoding is deliberately disabled. Root boundary operation is also src/packet.rs:164-166. Normative mapping-parent authority supports the observed rejection, not completed verification of the internal model. The separate no-EPH length assertion has narrower-clause test_error attribution and is not counted as another reproduced case.
